Direction from Jack Heart (2026-11-27) after MTG-497 Gate 1 revealed 0 arrays passed by pointer and 4.13 GB pickled in-band for Manabot `Prepared`:
1. In `src/etude/eval/bus.py`, teach `arrays()` and `_normalize()` to traverse `@dataclass` instances (`dataclasses.is_dataclass(item) and not isinstance(item, type)`, reading `dataclasses.fields(item)`, with cycle protection on `id(item)` and avoiding reconstruction in `_normalize()` when no leaf changed; if a nested non-NumPy buffer/DLPack leaf changes, reconstruct via `dataclasses.replace` or appropriate constructor, or copy cleanly when non-init fields exist). Note: also check nested dataclasses, dicts/lists/tuples inside dataclasses (like Manabot `Prepared` containing `ActionPrepared`, `LiveTokens`, `MemoryRows`, and `dict[str, np.ndarray]`), and both inputs and outputs (`pack_local_inputs` / `pack_local_outputs`).
2. Add contract tests in `tests/eval/test_bus.py` verifying nested frozen and mutable dataclasses containing C-contiguous NumPy arrays hit the zero-copy path on `LocalForwardBus`: `arrays > 0`, `arrays_copied == 0`, `pickled_bytes` is small metadata only (not array payload bytes), `Flight.lock` marks arrays read-only in flight and restores writeability afterward, and model in-place writes raise `ForwardError`.
3. Once implemented, re-run the M4 Max Gate 1 comparison against `~/src/manabot.mtg-497-support-gpu-batched` (`w160l8` + `w384l8`, MLX and MPS) to confirm `arrays > 0`, `arrays_copied == 0`, tiny `pickled_bytes`, and record the updated games/hr.
